name: Ramucirumab (single-agent anti-VEGFR2 antibody)
cyclesNote: Second-line, biomarker-selected for baseline AFP 400 ng/mL or higher after prior systemic therapy. 8 mg/kg IV every 2 weeks (days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle) until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antihistamine premedication
premedications.notes: H1 antagonist (e.g. diphenhydramine) before the ramucirumab infusion to reduce infusion-related reactions per labeling.

supportiveCare: Monitor blood pressure and urine protein (anti-VEGFR2 antibody).
Watch for infusion-related reactions during administration.

doseModificationRules.text: Hold or discontinue per labeling; resume only after control. Clinical review required.

drugs.name: Ramucirumab
drugs.notes: Ramucirumab 8 mg/kg IV every 2 weeks (days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle). Biomarker-selected second-line therapy for advanced HCC with baseline AFP 400 ng/mL or higher, Child-Pugh A. Premedicate with an antihistamine. Authored from standard practice (NCCN Hepatocellular Carcinoma; REACH-2 supporting evidence).
